change_description: Reduced mandatory prose without removing fields or structured judgements: correctness explanations now branch only on explicit disagreement and remain required; visibility, missing-label, sufficiency, project-knowledge and taxonomy explanations are optional. Follow-up semantic hardening preserves raw retained hidden values but masks them from derived completion and analysis when final parent responses make them inapplicable; defines blank optional prose as not provided and qualitative comments as non-prevalence enrichment; restores layer-specific visibility referents and protocol traceability/measurement-level wording.

Diagnostic signals support adjudication and do not by themselves establish a definitive error source.
